name: Kyonyuu na Aniyome wa Suki Desu ka? ~Teishuku na Tsuma ga Mesu e to Kawaru Toki~
original_name: 巨乳な兄嫁は好きですか？ ～貞淑な妻が牝へと変わる刻～
source:
After failing his entrance exams, the protagonist moves in with his older brother's family to attend a prep school in the city. Both the brother and his wife warmly welcome the protagonist, who arrives in the city filled with anxiety. As he settles into this new life, the protagonist discovers a side of his brother’s wife that he had never known before, and his feelings for her begin to take root.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.r18game.com/haoh/2017/aniyomestory.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
高考落榜后，为了去城里的补习学校复读，主人公搬进了哥哥嫂嫂家中借住。怀着满心忐忑来到大都市的主人公，受到了兄嫂二人热情温暖的欢迎。然而随着逐渐适应这段新生活，主人公无意间窥见了嫂嫂不为人知的另一面，对她的隐秘情愫也开始在心底悄然生根。

[译自[url=http://www.r18game.com/haoh/2017/aniyomestory.html]官方网站[/url]]
